I will farm this sorghum plot close to the way I did last season, but I will still put some fertilizer because the soil on this side does not carry the crop well without it. I have some schooling, so I watch costs and yield together, and for sorghum I will not spend too heavily unless I know the rain has started well. Since I own the land and I have other plots too, I will use a little manure where I can, plant improved seed if I get the same type the dealer had last time, spray herbicide to reduce weeding labor, and keep this plot rainfed.
